limitations: Six fresh task orders from two previously evaluated example banks; not fresh examples or cross-domain transfer.
Same improved allocator in both arms; prior allocator is not rerun on these orders, so no isolated causal estimate of allocator improvement.
Near-tie band five and one-child quota fixed before evaluation. No post-freeze tuning.
Initial callable ordering remains inherited from the frozen memory manager; finite-budget results need not be invariant to every permutation.
Scoring, memory selection, canonicalization, retention and utilities unchanged. No seeded learned methods.
No text/tree, subgraph extraction, parameterization or consolidation changes.
policy: Frozen previous score and memory rules. Root singleton layer completes as before. Thereafter each parent receives one child attempt before returning to the queue. Among parents within five integer priority units of the best, choose the least-served (smallest next_i); FIFO breaks equal service counts. Returned parents go to the tail. Better scores outside that band retain priority. Beam 100; exact expanded-sequence dedup; expanded length <=5; all nested execution and allocation work charged. Fairness is by child attempts, not equal CPU or graph work per parent.
